entities.summary: Harold Huyton Francis, known as Tim Francis, was a New Zealand diplomat. He was the nation's permanent representative to the United Nations from 1978 to 1982, and Ambassador to the United States from 1988 to 1991. From 1984 to 1988, he was the Administrator of Tokelau,
